bonus_depreciation.summary: 100% bonus depreciation is PERMANENT under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (signed July 4, 2025) for qualified property ACQUIRED and PLACED IN SERVICE after January 19, 2025 — no phase-down schedule. Property placed in service Jan 1-19, 2025 gets 40%; transitional elections allow 40%/60% on certain post-Jan-19 property. Restores full first-year value of cost-segregation studies on short-life components of acquired buildings.
bonus_depreciation.note: Multiple independent national tax practices concur on dates and permanence; IRC section text not directly fetched from this environment.

section_1031.summary: No change to like-kind exchanges identified in the OBBBA per reviewed practitioner coverage — real-property 1031 remains available under pre-existing law (TCJA limits: real property only).
section_1031.note: Stated as absence-of-change across reviewed sources rather than an affirmative statutory confirmation.

opportunity_zones_2.summary: OZ program made PERMANENT by OBBBA. New designations every 10 years — first round designated July 1, 2026, EFFECTIVE January 1, 2027; old zones overlap until December 31, 2028. Post-2026 investments get a rolling 5-year deferral. Rural enhancements: substantial-improvement basis requirement lowered to 50% for rural-QOZ property (determinations on/after July 4, 2025); new rural QOF investments get a 30% basis step-up.
